description: This Java source file defines a class 'WeightedPermissions' that manages collections of granted and revoked permissions, including methods to add permissions, filter by highest weight, and retrieve the collections.

classes.name: WeightedPermissions
classes.description: A mutable and unsorted collection of granted and revoked WeightedPermission objects, providing methods to manipulate and query these permissions.

methods.name: WeightedPermissions
methods.description: Constructor initializing empty sets of granted and revoked permissions.

methods.name: getAllGranted
methods.description: Returns all granted permissions; changes to the returned set affect the internal state.

methods.name: getGrantedWithHighestWeight
methods.description: Returns a map of granted permissions with the highest weight for each specified permission name.

methods.name: addGranted
methods.description: Adds a WeightedPermission to the granted set.

methods.name: addGranted
methods.description: Creates and adds a WeightedPermission with specified permission name and weight to granted set.

methods.name: addGranted
methods.description: Adds multiple permissions with the specified weight to the granted set.

methods.name: getAllRevoked
methods.description: Returns all revoked permissions; changes to the returned set affect the internal state.

methods.name: getRevokedWithHighestWeight
methods.description: Returns a map of revoked permissions with the highest weight for each specified permission name.

methods.name: addRevoked
methods.description: Adds a WeightedPermission to the revoked set.

methods.name: addRevoked
methods.description: Creates and adds a WeightedPermission with specified permission name and weight to revoked set.

methods.name: addRevoked
methods.description: Adds multiple permissions with the specified weight to the revoked set.
